listing.name: Action Man: Mission Xtreme — ActionManRecomp (GnomeChimpsky)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream preview boots/plays tested parts; full playthrough not verified. Linux virtual-display-only and Windows cross-compile evidence must not become physical/native host gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation PAL SLES-01761 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the project’s ZIP for your system, open the ActionManRecomp launcher and select your own PAL SLES-01761 CUE/BIN. The project describes background level compilation and caching. This guide does not confirm the integrity of the generated files or the separate patch-and-build route.
